capabilities: Index user-selected hidden root-level folders into the vault cache
Show hidden-folder files in file explorer, Quick Switcher, search, and graph
Propagate create, modify, rename, and delete events via filesystem watchers
Query hidden-folder notes from Bases, Dataview, and vault-API plugins
Remove all injected entries when a folder or the plugin is disabled
disambiguation: Not for hiding or protecting folders; it does the opposite, making already-hidden dot-folders visible inside Obsidian.
extras: Desktop-only and requires Obsidian 1.13.0+ (declarative settings API); full user documentation lives in docs/. Warns that third-party sync plugins (Remotely Save, LiveSync, obsidian-git) may not exclude hidden paths and to test on a copy with backups; notes other plugins can now modify the exposed files.
intentEvidence: makes hidden root-level folders (names starting with a dot, e.g. .claude, .github) fully visible to Obsidian
motivation: The author wanted content in dot-folders to participate in search, the link graph, and Bases without renaming folders or using symlinks that break Obsidian Sync and cross-platform workflows.
problem: Obsidian ignores all paths starting with a dot, so content stored in folders like .claude or .github cannot be searched, linked, or queried without renaming them (which breaks external tools) or using symlinks (which break Sync).

relations.evidence: Full integration: file explorer, Quick Switcher, search, graph, metadata cache, Bases, Dataview
Obsidian Sync: safe. Sync never syncs paths starting with .

summary: Vault-index plugin that injects whitelisted hidden root-level dot-folders (e.g. .claude) into Obsidian's file tree, search, graph, metadata cache and Bases.
